name: Gastritis
overview: Gastritis is inflammation of the stomach lining, causing upper abdominal pain, nausea, and bloating. H. pylori infection, NSAIDs, and alcohol are common causes in India.
diagnosis: H. pylori stool antigen or urea breath test
Upper endoscopy with biopsy when indicated
treatment: PPI or H2 blocker for symptom relief
H. pylori eradication triple therapy when confirmed
prevention: Limit NSAID use; take with food or gastroprotection if prescribed
emergencySigns: Dizziness or fainting from blood loss

faq.question: Can I rely on this Gastritis information instead of a doctor visit?
faq.answer: No. This content supports learning and preparation for conversations with qualified healthcare professionals. It is not a substitute for diagnosis or treatment.

faq.question: What should I do if Gastritis symptoms worsen suddenly?
faq.answer: Seek urgent medical care, especially if severe pain, breathing difficulty, confusion, or high fever develops.
